run.input_snapshot: InfoLink internal 2026-11-18 (ESS weekly): 314Ah cell 0.32-0.37 CNY/Wh (avg 0.345); 280Ah 0.32-0.37 (avg 0.345); AC-side 2h system 0.52-0.63 (avg 0.58); AC-side 4h system 0.50-0.55 (avg 0.53); DC-side 2h system 0.44-0.52 (avg 0.48). CNESA internal 2026-09: system awarded averages 2h 653.1 / 4h 529.1 CNY/kWh; EPC awarded averages (excl. PC) 2h 1005.5 / 4h 882.8 CNY/kWh; turnkey adder = EPC minus system = 2h 352.4 / 4h 353.7 CNY/kWh (same-source same-month difference, used for cross-checking). TND-AGG published points are currently 0, so this model takes no tender-aggregate price input; re-basing follows QC #85 landing
run.assumptions: v0.1 minimal recomputable model; assumptions flagged item by item (assumption): DC-side other BOM 0.10 CNY/Wh (0.08-0.13); PCS + transformer + EMS + AC protection adder 2h 0.09 (0.07-0.12) / 4h 0.06 (0.045-0.08) CNY/Wh; LCOE: life 15 years (12-20), discount rate 8% (6-10%), 300 cycles/year (200-365), DoD 90%, RTE 88% (85-92%), fixed O&M 1.5% of CAPEX per year (1-2%); degradation not modelled (v0.1 simplification, registered); the main LCOE table excludes charging cost, shown separately at 0.25 CNY/kWh / RTE; cell and system prices are MKT-ASSESS internal assessed values (point values not published externally); this model's outputs are WA-CALC transformed products
